limitations: Validation/test plants have been historically inspected; this is not an external untouched holdout.
Shared V142 D topology; instance/seed split disjoint but not independent botanical families.
Distance stratification is camera-to-aim-point per complete view; background plants may be at other distances.
Native patch resizing adds no optical detail; camera captures provide the different scale.
Eligible filtering is not a universal YOLO limit and must always be accompanied by all-object metrics.
Class labels describe calyx appearance, not internal fruit maturity.
Source dataset currently contains no complete negative views or empty crops.
Fixed-threshold precision/recall/F1, not AP; wrong-class spatial matches count as FP andFN.

max_det=300 per tile is identical and fixed for both models. Some dataset crops contain more than300true instances (observed maximum342); the prediction cap can limit dense-scene recall. It is not raised based on test results.
